reinforced_checks.rule: All new endpoints/Edge Functions require JWT auth unless explicitly public
LLM selection via router (D016): Ollama free default → DeepSeek → Claude ONLY on admin request. Never hardcode a heavy model.
pgvector queries must have ivfflat index and cosine distance; embeddings run on Ollama (free).
Matching/summarization/meta-learning must cost zero Claude tokens.
No external web search/scraping. Only fetch a consulted listing URL to verify it is a property (D019).
Scheduled jobs go through secret-key-protected Edge Functions (D018). Never expose the trigger without the secret.
Visit scheduling requires explicit advisor confirmation before booking (M1/F112).
On low-confidence matches due to missing data (e.g. m²), request completion from the involved advisor (offer→listing agent, demand→assigned agent) before validating — request-data-completion (D022).
